components.name: Workspace navigation
components.description: One active tab; application logic provides keyboard selection and retained panels.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:32px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#c5c5c5)}.ds-tabs button{font:400 17px/1.5 Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;min-height:50px;padding:14px 0;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-1px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#626262);cursor:pointer}.ds-tabs button[aria-selected="true"]{border-bottom-color:var(--foreground,#111);color:var(--foreground,#111);font-weight:600}.ds-tabs button:hover{color:var(--foreground,#111)}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--foreground,#111);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Preference switch
components.description: Checkbox switch with the only animated treatment in the interface.
components.css: .ds-switch{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-height:28px;cursor:pointer;font:13px/1.5 Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--foreground,#111);white-space:nowrap}.ds-switch input{appearance:none;margin:0;width:30px;height:18px;border:1px solid var(--muted,#626262);border-radius:12px;position:relative;background:transparent;cursor:pointer}.ds-switch input::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--muted,#626262);transition:transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}.ds-switch input:checked{border-color:var(--foreground,#111);background:var(--foreground,#111)}.ds-switch input:checked::after{background:var(--background,#fff);transform:translateX(12px)}.ds-switch input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--foreground,#111);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-switch input::after{transition:none}}@media(forced-colors:active){.ds-switch input{appearance:auto}.ds-switch input::after{display:none}}

narrative.overview:
A Swiss, minimalist workspace for optical file exchange. Black, white, neutral grays, local Helvetica, whitespace, and thin rules keep the file and its QR artifact central. The interface reverses cleanly between light and dark without changing the transfer pixels.

One workspace is visible at a time. Controls occupy a compact left rail; the output receives the larger right region. State remains in the tab when the user switches between Encode and Receive.
keyCharacteristics: Reversible monochrome interface; invariant black-on-white QR output.
One visible task, retained in-tab work, direct status and recovery actions.
Asymmetric workspace, square controls, thin dividers, no decorative depth.
Local system typography and no external fonts or UI framework.

rules.name: The Transfer Pixels Rule
rules.body: Theme changes reverse interface roles only. QR modules remain pure black on white.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use whitespace, thin rules, and surface tone to distinguish regions. Do not introduce shadows.

dos: Do preserve both workspace DOM trees and their in-tab state when switching modes.
Do keep text status, visible focus, native field semantics, and explicit cancel/retry/save actions.
Do use the existing local Helvetica/Arial stack and tabular numerals for transfer values.
Do describe export as using up to 10 FPS; the playback input can accept 1–30 FPS.
donts: Don't reintroduce the rejected green palette, decorative cards, or downloaded fonts.
Don't invert QR pixels in dark mode or add decorative motion.
Don't hide progress or remove the persistent Save video alternative after export.
